editorialLimits: Explicit user canon and established quest narration/outcomes govern. Character explanations, journals, guardian accounts, personal promises and theories remain attributed.

Discovery searches across external exports are not exhaustive archive reading. Only selected quest, route and native location windows and the 435 cited versions are checked. Earlier references retain their prior scope; inaccessible threads and unreviewed attachments are not newly read.

The original main-quest export has preserved local-offset timestamps and DiscordChatExporter payloads; it is distinguished from native API cache rows. Matching identities does not imply that all versions are API-native or that repeated cache occurrences are independent evidence.

Named approaches, repeated entrances and narrator descriptions establish location associations. A source channel, similar scenery, shared participants or a later recollection alone does not establish a match.

The four-pillar hold is Kûn Ardaire in Old Earth Hills within Prima. It is not merged with the harpy cave, quarry, Before survey, seven-glyph city or storm cave. No precise map pin, ancient calendar conversion or complete underground plan is invented.

The quarry journey turns off in the foothills while heading toward Alpine Forest. Its direction does not place the quarry inside that forest. The First Forest mist creates an apparent Pristinia; it does not move or destroy the real settlement.

The Cove harvesting descent is distinct from the earlier Cathedral wheel scene. A useful shore, defeated guards and a successful retreat do not establish a cleared underwater temple or completed refugee salvage.

Temple of Secrets is supported by the shore structure, native descriptions and explicit quest recognition of the Veiled Watch. Murr sets off toward a proposed memory lead; no completed library test or recovered memory is shown. Subsequent days of travel remain elsewhere.

The owl knows stories of Pappy’s parents but says it never knew them or their fate. Cerwin’s hope that the Knights can help Severina is not a recorded resurrection. Later active appearances do not supply the missing return scene.

Protected later material, private writing, controller data, raw transcripts, unreviewed media, rules tables and generic/joke identities remain excluded. All existing art, previews and the complete private payload remain exact.

Four existing timeline objects receive geography/context-source clarifications only. Titles, original dates, calendar values, sort keys, importance, participants and region assignments remain exact. No new event or forced same-day adjustment is added.
